message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts. Two crimes: theft (盗窃) and illegal possession of firearms (非法持有枪支). In examples, they used labels like "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" for illegal possession. But here only illegal possession of gun, no ammunition. Example earlier: "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" used for case of illegal possession and private storage of guns and ammunition. Another example: "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" appears. Also "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" is the label. For just illegal possession, maybe "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" still used. In earlier example: "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" used for case where they had bird gun and hunting gun. That included both. So we can use same label.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗窃;非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药<eoa>
